BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning the delivery of electronic admission tickets.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the delivery of electronic admission tickets; and adding a new section to chapter 19.345 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 19.345 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: A ticket seller must immediately deliver an electronic admission ticket upon receiving confirmation of payment.
